field.name: datetime
field.impl: const iotdata_field_datetime_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, quantise_datetime(v->datetime_secs), IOTDATA_DATETIME_BITS);

const iotdata_field_datetime_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s day %" PRIu32 " %02" PRIu32 ":%02" PRIu32 ":%02" PRIu32 " (%" PRIu32 "s)\n", label, _padd(label), v->datetime_secs / 86400, (v->datetime_secs % 86400) / 3600, (v->datetime_secs % 3600) / 60, v->datetime_secs % 60, v->datetime_secs);
